value.rationale: The count of nondominated alternatives and dominated hypervolume are fundamental but different summaries of Pareto quality. Their dependence for the same iid sample is not determined by skyline count limits. A complete sign law and exact position-resolved mixed covariance show an unexpected negative association at every nontrivial size, and an asymptotic comparison to expected uncovered area quantifies its scale. This naturally motivated joint statistic is not merely a known marginal count formula or arbitrary parameter specialization.
